## Import data

```{r}
load("data/Herring_full.Rdata")

source("R/functions.R")
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
results_cpt <- changepoint_analysis(Herring_full, 
                                          region_name = "Full Stock",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.5,
                                          ssb_col = "SSB")
# CPT changepoint indices:  4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72 
# CPT changepoint years:    1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  20,   37,   54 
# BCP changepoint years:    1966, 1983, 2000 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1966, 2000 
# CPT only: 1950, 1964, 1986, 2018 
# BCP only: 1983 
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Call "breakpoint_analysis" function
results_brkpt <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "F", "year",
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Full Stock")

# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.25  1.43  0.43  0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1960, 1971, 1986, 2000 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, results_brkpt$break_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")
Herring_full <- Herring_full[-c(1:3, 78:79), ]

models_SRR <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring_full,
  recruit_col = "Recruitment", 
  ssb_col = "SSB",
  max_breaks = 4,
  use_bic = TRUE)

models_SRR[["comparison_table"]]

#### Bad overdispertion for GLM's exept nebinom
#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE, seg.log best R_squared

### Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis"
results_SRR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "Recruitment", "year", "Herring Full", method = "segmented")

# Running segmented model analysis
# Using mean SSB as initial psi: 1537513 
# Segmented model breakpoint:
# SSB breakpoint: 579189.1 ± 118213.4 
# Approximate year: 1983 

# Call function "cross_valid" for performing loocv for all models
Herring_full$R_log <- log(Herring_full$Recruitment)
Herring_full$SSB_lag_log <- log(Herring_full$SSB_lag)

dat <- Herring_full[, c(1, 7:10)]
names(dat) <- c("Year", "R", "SSB_lag", "R_log", "SSB_lag_log")

rmse_mean_herring <- cross_valid(dataset = dat)
# linear      beverton    ricker      segmented   seg.log     seg.glm     strucchange
# 10760358    10439657    11540811    11258361    10458588    10998288    14456985
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, break_years = results_SRR$breakpoint_year, "Full Stock", "segmented-log")
plot_SRR_full
```

#### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SRR_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# tGAM

```{r}
## Load env and cpr data
load("data/env_df_full.Rdata")
load("data/cpr_full.Rdata")

tGAM_data <- list()

## Autumn based analysis
### Merge env data to fish
tGAM_data$autumn <- Herring_full %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$phyto %>% filter(Season == "Autumn"), 
            by = c("year" = "Year")) %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$small %>% filter(Season == "Autumn"), 
            by = c("year" = "Year"), suffix = c("_phyto", "_small")) %>%
  left_join(env_df_full %>% filter(Season == "Autumn"), 
            by = c("year")) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, Recruitment, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS, 
                phytoplankton = average_food_phyto, small_zooplankton = average_food_small)

### Run threshold GAM function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$autumn, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 12.7599
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$autumn, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 10.5124
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$autumn, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 34.4627
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$autumn, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "phytoplankton", "year") 
#### Time range: 1958 - 2021    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 124756.6 
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$autumn, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "small_zooplankton", "year")
#### Time range: 1958 - 2021    LOOCV result: TRUE    Model MR: 847.3968

#### Significant threshold found for small zooplankton

##  Lagged autumn based analysis
### Merge env data to fish
tGAM_data$lagged <- Herring_full %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$phyto %>% filter(Season == "Autumn") %>% mutate(Year = Year + 1), 
            by = c("year" = "Year")) %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$small %>% filter(Season == "Autumn") %>% mutate(Year = Year + 1), 
            by = c("year" = "Year"), suffix = c("_phyto", "_small")) %>%
  left_join(env_df_full %>% filter(Season == "Autumn") %>% mutate(year = year + 1), 
            by = c("year")) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, Recruitment, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS, 
                phytoplankton = average_food_phyto, small_zooplankton = average_food_small)

### Run threshold GAM function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$lagged, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year")
#### Time range: 1994 - 2024    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 12.4188 
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$lagged, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year")
#### Time range: 1994 - 2024    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 10.1526 
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$lagged, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year")
#### Time range: 1994 - 2024    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 34.4627 
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$lagged, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "phytoplankton", "year") 
#### Time range: 1959 - 2022    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 101237.4  
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$lagged, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "small_zooplankton", "year")
#### Time range: 1959 - 2022    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 847.3968 

#### No significant threshold

##  Year based analysis
### Merge env data to fish
tGAM_data$year <- Herring_full %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$phyto %>% 
            group_by(Year) %>% 
            summarise(phytoplankton = mean(average_food, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop'), 
            by = c("year" = "Year")) %>%
  left_join(cpr_full$small %>% 
            group_by(Year) %>% 
            summarise(small_zooplankton = mean(average_food, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop'), 
            by = c("year" = "Year")) %>%
  left_join(env_df_full %>%
            group_by(year) %>%
            summarise(across(starts_with("Mean_"), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop'),
            by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB_lag, Recruitment, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS, 
                phytoplankton, small_zooplankton)

### Run threshold GAM function from "functions" with each variable
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$year, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 10.5013  
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$year, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 8.5684  
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$year, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year")
#### Time range: 1993 - 2023    LOOCV result: FALSE   Model MR: 34.4184  
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$year, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "phytoplankton", "year") 
#### Time range: 1958 - 2021    LOOCV result: TRUE    Model MR: 123351.8   
run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data$year, "Recruitment", "SSB_lag", "small_zooplankton", "year")
#### Time range: 1958 - 2021    LOOCV result: TRUE    Model MR: 953.3124  

#### Significant threshold found for phytoplankton and small zooplankton
```
